prompts.veterinarian: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create an original premium website feature-card photograph for an Indian pet care marketplace. Landscape 3:2, warm natural light, realistic anatomy, clean professional sage-green and cream palette. Important subjects grouped centrally in the upper two thirds, generous margins so faces stay visible in small card crops; uncluttered lower portion for a separate UI caption. No printed words, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, borders or UI layout. No farm animals. Scene: an Indian male veterinarian in his thirties wearing a clean teal scrub shirt and stethoscope, gently examining a calm golden retriever on a clinic table. A small domestic cat sits beside the dog. Bright modern veterinary clinic, cream walls, softly blurred shelves and green plants. Caring, trustworthy and approachable mood, show the veterinarian's face and both animals clearly.
